text: I I love the Lord, who listenedto my voice in supplication,
Who turned an ear to meon the day I called.
I was caught by the cords of death; [1] [AA]the snares of Sheol had seized me;I felt agony and dread.
Then I called on the name of the Lord,"O Lord, save my life!"
II Gracious is the Lord and righteous;yes, our God is merciful. [AB]
The Lord protects the simple;I was helpless, but he saved me.
Return, my soul, to your rest;the Lord has been very good to you. [AC]
For my soul has been freed from death,my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling. [AD]
I shall walk before the Lordin the land of the living. [2] [AE]
III [3]I kept faith, even when I said,"I am greatly afflicted!" [AF]
I said in my alarm,"All men are liars!" [AG]
How can I repay the Lordfor all the great good done for me?
I will raise the cup of salvation [4]and call on the name of the Lord.
I will pay my vows to the Lordin the presence of all his people.
t[5]Dear in the eyes of the Lordis the death of his devoted. [AH]
Lord, I am your servant,your servant, the child of your maidservant; [AI]you have loosed my bonds.
I will offer a sacrifice of praiseand call on the name of the Lord. [AJ]
I will pay my vows to the Lord [AK]in the presence of all his people,
In the courts of the house of the Lord,in your midst, O Jerusalem.Hallelujah!
